note: Report coverage pins that a human has re-verified by reading after the cited dossier moved past the pin. Reports are immutable once published (PROFILER-SCHEMA.md → Report schema), so an aged pin is never edited; this list records that the drift was checked. scripts/check-profiler-reports.py stays quiet on a pin while the dossier sits at verifiedAt and warns again once it moves past it — the re-warning is intended, not a bug. One entry per (report, slug). verifiedAt is the dossier profileVersion the pin was verified against; pinnedVersion is what the report still carries. Superseded reports are not tracked here (the checker skips their pin drift). Record: PROFILER-COVERAGE-PLAN.md §9.3 (X3b).
